mapper.sql: id AS place_id, name, biz_type AS kind, address, latitude AS lat, longitude AS lng, image_url, ROUND(ST_Distance(geom, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{lng}, #{lat}), 4326)::geography))::int AS distance
mapper.select: SELECT FROM retrip_place WHERE content_type_id = '32' AND ST_DWithin(geom, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{lng}, #{lat}), 4326)::geography, #{radius}) ORDER BY CASE WHEN biz_type = '호텔' AND image_url IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, geom <-> ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{lng}, #{lat}), 4326)::geography LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM retrip_place WHERE id = #{placeId} AND content_type_id = '32'
